offers.title: VIE Functional Excellence Support (H/F)
offers.description: Join the technological revolution of autonomous and connected vehicles at Valeo! World leader in driving aids, Valeo Brain is reinventing life on board the vehicle and revolutionizing the driving experience. From connectivity and interior control solutions to sensing systems, we make mobility safer and more intuitive. The site of Bietigheim-Bissingen based in Germany belongs to BRAIN Division. We are looking for a VIE Functional Excellence Support for 12 months within the team. Your challenges? You will be responsible for leading continuous improvement initiatives within the department, which will involve analyzing current operational processes, identifying areas for optimization, and supporting the implementation of best practices and new tools. You drive continuous improvement initiatives within the function You analyze current operational processes and identify areas for optimization You support the deployment of best practices and new tools You manage small-scale projects to enhance efficiency and cross-functional collaboration You bring expertise to optimize local processes and deploy global best practices You strengthen site performance and support competitiveness within the group

offers.title: TALENT ACQUISITION SPECIALIST BERLIN (H/F)
offers.description: Cher/Chère Talent Acquisition Specialist, Bienvenue chez CBTW, où nous exploitons le pouvoir de la collaboration pour créer et fournir des solutions technologiques et business innovantes. Nous sommes une équipe innovante de plus de 3 000 employés dans 21 pays, experts dans la stratégie, la cybersécurité, l'ingénierie logicielle, l'IA, et plus encore. A Berlin, nous sommes à la recherche d'un(e) Talent Acquisition Specialist pour rejoindre notre équipe ! How you’ll Make an Impact > Recrutement Consultant de Profils IT/Tech - Participer activement au cycle complet de recrutement pour des postes IT/Tech, notamment développeurs, DevOps, Product Owners, Data Analysts, etc. - Sourcer des talents via des canaux variés tels que LinkedIn, job boards, et bases de données internes. - Préqualifier les candidats par des entretiens téléphoniques et coordonner les étapes suivantes du processus avec les managers opérationnels. > Reporting et Suivi des KPI - Contribuer au suivi des indicateurs de performance clés (KPI) tels que le délai de recrutement, le taux de conversion des entretiens et la satisfaction des candidats. - Partager régulièrement des mises à jour sur les activités de recrutement avec le Talent Acquisition Manager et les équipes Sales. - Identifier des axes d’amélioration dans les pratiques de recrutement et proposer des ajustements pour gagner en efficacité.

offers.title: Field Engineer (H/F)

offers.title: JR HR PMO (H/F)
offers.description: At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world. TE’s HR Business Partners implement Human Resources policies at the business unit level partnering with management to drive company-wide programs and initiatives (i.e. succession, talent acquisition, total rewards and change management). They foster partnership across the HR function to deliver value-added service to management and employees that reflects the business objectives, strategies and policies of the organization. Job Overview Are you passionate about driving impactful changes in Human Resources through data, structure, and strategic execution? We’re looking for a dynamic Jr HR PMO to support our global HR initiatives. This hybrid role offers the opportunity to work at the heart of a purpose-driven, international organization while being based in one of our preferred European locations. (Switzerland, Germany, Spain, Portugal, Island, Netherland or Belgium) As an HR PMO, you will play a key role in enhancing the efficiency, consistency, and quality of HR projects by leading standardized processes, implementing best practices, and supporting strategic people initiatives. You will have the opportunity to work closely with senior HR Leaders in an international environment. Responsibilities and Duties - Support the Transportation Solutions & Auto HR PMO in all HR processes and activities regarding: Talent, Training, Organization and Culture and any ad-hoc topics depending on business needs. - Provide support to coordinate and drive the annual HR Calendar and related initiatives considering our regional, global, and segment objectives and timelines. - Prepare and organize the HR Leadership meetings (calendar, agenda, stakeholder coordination, etc…) ensuring productive outcomes and actionable follow-ups. - Compile, analyze and interpret data from various HR systems and tools and develop reports and presentations to help leadership make informed decisions. - Lead the tracking and reporting of HR KPIs, with a strong focus on talent management and succession pipeline - Establishes and promotes the use of best practices across the HR team. - Analize Employee Engagement survey results, and identify key strengths and opportunities - Executive Development Program : Tracking project progress, budget, timelines, and deliverables. - Manage sensitive and highly confidential proprietary information with discretion and utmost confidentiality.

offers.title: Contract Management (m/f) (H/F)
offers.description: At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars. Could you be the VIE Project Contract Manager in Braunschweig looking for? Your future role Take on a new challenge and apply your expertise in contract management in a dynamic and innovative environment. You’ll work alongside collaborative and forward-thinking teammates. You'll play a pivotal role in ensuring the successful execution of contracts and safeguarding Alstom’s interests. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (such as project management, finance, engineering, and sourcing), develop and implement contract strategies, and proactively mitigate risks, among other responsibilities. You’ll specifically take care of managing contractual obligations and claims, but also fostering a culture of proactive contract management within the project team. We’ll look to you for: • Driving contract management activities and providing leadership to project contract managers and administrators. • Developing and implementing a Contract Management Strategy Plan (CMSP) in collaboration with the Core Project Team. • Ensuring compliance with contract governance and timely issuance of contractual notices to customers and partners. • Establishing and implementing project-specific commercial procedures, including documentation, notifications, and claims preparation files. • Monitoring project schedules to ensure adherence to contractual milestones and obligations. • Providing creative and pragmatic advice on contractual issues, risks, and claims activities. • Preparing and managing all documentation for claims and counterclaims negotiations. • Delivering training on contract and claim management to project stakeholders. • Collaborating with cross-functional teams to identify risks, maximize opportunities, and ensure compliance with contractual terms. • Preparation and drafting contractual and legal documentation. • Preparation and drafting customer and supplier letters.

offers.title: D&IS Product Marketing (H/F)
offers.description: Could you be the full-time Product Line Marketing VIE in Berlin we’re looking for? Your future role Take on a new challenge and apply your marketing and product positioning expertise in a cutting-edge field. You’ll work alongside dynamic and innovative teammates. You'll play a crucial role in shaping how our Digital & Integrated Systems solutions are perceived in the market. Our portfolio spans from signalling, turnkey systems to digital solutions and infrastructure. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (product management, sales, and communication teams), create impactful marketing materials, and coordinate the communication of our solutions’ vision and value to internal and external stakeholders. It is a global role, based in Berlin. You’ll specifically take care of developing marketing tools and collaterals, but also support in building awareness campaigns to highlight our solutions. We’ll look to you for: Building messaging, value propositions, and differentiated product positioning for relevant solutions Developing and maintaining marketing product collaterals (e.g., presentations, videos, product sheets) and ensuring updates Creating and managing a marketing tools platform Coordinating marketing expectations from the sales network Supporting internal communication through webinars and other activities to ensure alignment Developing white papers, presentations, and pitches to highlight our product offerings

offers.title: JUNIOR WAGON ENGINEER (H/F)
offers.description: Junior Wagon Engineer (JWE) is in the process of technical education and is supporting Wagon Engineers (WE) and Safety Engineer (SE) in operations related to ensuring safety of wagons and limiting maintenance costs and down-time to a minimum. He is supporting the on-site inspections and monitoring of the maintenance suppliers but also giving daily support to Fleet Management team. Technical understanding and capacity of analysis are the main characteristics of this function. The mission of JWE is: Maintenance: - Monitor the maintenance suppliers by technical visits/audits (according to Technical Visit Plan DT- 239) and quality checks (wagon exit inspections) in agreement with WE/SE, - Support investigations on sites, - Establish instructions for corrective repairs and select the workshop to perform it (for damages on tracks) as a backup of WE - Support the realization of maintenance with the maintenance suppliers as a backup to WE: o Establishing necessary technical instructions to workshops, o Providing technical support to workshops, o Validate the revision dates of wagons and wheelsets and any extensions as required, o Support WE in identification of parts and processing spare parts requests , o Support Fleet Managers in validation of exit documentation, o Ensure the recording and traceability of maintenance, - Make workshops fulfill their requirements (downtimes, quality claims, documentation), - Actively support Fleet Managers when required in establishing proof of Lessee responsibility. Deliveries/Redeliveries: - Deliver support for Fleet Managers and Wagon Resource Manager on Deliveries/Redeliveries of wagons, - Under supervision of WE perform the Delivery/Redelivery inspections, incl. support to Fleet Managers for rebilling ECM responsibilities: - Support WE/SE in development of TOUAX’s maintenance manuals, - Support WE/SE in collection of return of experience from maintenance providers, customers and RUs, - Support WE/SE in investigations on incident reports Wagon fleet: - Support WE in creation and managing of parts and part types in Kheops for the Purchase and Logistics Activity. Interfaces: With which other functions (internal and external) does the function interact? Internal functions: - Technical Department Maintenance Organization Manager) - Logistics Department - Quality Department External functions: - Maintenance suppliers - Customers - Railway Undertakings

offers.title: Chargée(e) de mission "numérique et start-ups" au SER de Berlin (H/F)
offers.description: Le Service économique régional (SER) de Berlin, sous l’autorité du chef du SER, est composé de 20 agents et organisé en cinq pôles : pôle soutien ; pôle macroéconomie/finances ; pôle économie, industrie et numérique ; pôle développement durable, énergie et transport ; pôle agricole. MISSION ET ATTRIBUTIONS DU VIA : Le/la VIA assurera la fonction de chargé(e) de mission numérique et start-ups au sein du SER. Il/elle travaillera sous l’autorité directe de l’adjoint/conseiller économique en charge du pôle économie, industrie, numérique, en lien étroit avec la responsable du secteur industrie et les collègues du pôle (5 agents + 1 stagiaire au total). A ce titre, il/elle aura pour principales missions : • veille et suivi de la coopération franco-allemande sous ses différentes formes sur les politiques numériques et start-ups en Allemagne, à travers la presse, les séminaires, des entretiens avec les acteurs concernés et les échanges d’information avec les entreprises ; • production de mails flashs, de notes et d’études comparatives internationales (ECI) pour l’administration centrale et pour l’Ambassadeur relatifs aux enjeux du numérique et de l’environnement start-ups, et participation à l’écriture de la veille sectorielle mensuelle ; • contribution à la préparation de rencontres bilatérales (déplacements/entretiens de l’Ambassadeur, délégations ministérielles, missions parlementaires, rencontres de haut niveau entre les ministères…) et organisation d’évènements à l’Ambassade et à la Résidence ; • représentation du service auprès de divers interlocuteurs (autres services de l’Ambassade, entreprises et communauté d’affaires, ministères…), coordination du réseau French Tech Allemagne en lien étroit avec la Mission French Tech et Business France ; • appui de la DGE dans divers groupes de travail (ex : groupe de travail numérique de la PF G7, groupe de travail sur la définition de services numériques souverains) et réponses à des sollicitations ponctuelles (demandes d’information, démarches auprès des Ministères fédéraux) En fonction des compétences de l’agent et des nécessités de service, le périmètre du poste pourra être adapté. En tant que de besoin, l’agent pourra travailler sur des sujets transversaux et être amené à contribuer à toute demande ponctuelle dans l’intérêt du Service économique régional. Ces travaux nécessitent de maintenir une bonne collaboration avec les différents services de l’ambassade (service scientifique, chancellerie, services d’appui événementiel, etc.), les consulats, les autres agences (Business France, BPI France), la French Tech et bien sûr l’administration centrale (DG Trésor et DGE). Le travail implique de nouer un réseau de contacts avec l’administration allemande, les entreprises et fédérations allemandes, l’écosystème franco-allemand de la tech. Exemples de travaux récents : • note sur le cloud et les centres de données en Allemagne • note de cadrage sur la souveraineté numérique • questionnaire sur l’état des lieux du quantique en Allemagne • étude Comparative Internationale sur l’intégration de l’IA dans l’administration publique • appui de la DGE et organisation de la visite de 3 Ministres dans le cadre d’un Sommet sur la souveraineté numérique européenne organisé par la France et l’Allemagne à Berlin PROFIL : Formation de niveau Master 2 : école de commerce, IEP, université dans le domaine concerné. Une première expérience à l'étranger sur les enjeux économiques, voire numériques internationaux (formation supérieure ou stage en Service économique/Chancellerie), serait un avantage. COMPETENCES REQUISES : • capacité d’analyse, de synthèse et de rédaction • maîtrise de la langue allemande et langue anglaise (C1 minimum) • bonne connaissance de l’environnement économique allemand SAVOIRS-ETRE : • polyvalence et capacité d’adaptation • devoir de discrétion • sens du service public • qualités relationnelles • capacité à travailler en équipe • réactivité (aptitude à produire ponctuellement dans l’urgence) • curiosité intellectuelle, esprit d’initiative DIVERS : Berlin est une ville dynamique, jeune et attractive offrant une haute qualité de vie. Présence de nombreux VIA, stagiaires et jeunes agents de recrutement local au sein du service et de l’ambassade. Situation du logement tendue à Berlin impliquant d’anticiper la recherche d’un appartement.

offers.title: TECHNICIEN SERVICE CLIENT (H/F)
offers.description: Présentation de la société: Entreprise de renommée internationale pour la fabrication de machines dédiées à la déformation du fil, du tube et du méplat, NUMALLIANCE est une ETI dynamique et innovante. offers.title: Technology training support (H/F)
offers.description: Enaex is a premium blasting solutions partner present in all the main mining regions. Tasks: Map the blasting operational process and associate its challenges; Map the regional know-how related to the use of initiation systems; Support in managing the user certification database; Support to create educational content related to product training; To be the bridge between the French and regional teams to guarantee an optimal follow-up. Communicate effectively with mining countries/customers. Your tasks strike a superb balance between understanding teamwork dynamics in an international context and discovering the specific operational characteristics of the country through the application of our electronic initiation systems. You will be given the opportunity to go out into the field and learn about various mines Training in France before departure: 1 to 2 months Local conditions: Your first month's rent will be covered in full. offers.title: Corporate Credit Analyst (H/F)
